codeTourBubble: Hi, I'm Kun. Tell me what you want to build. Reading code, editing files and running commands are on me.
codeTourWelcomeTitle: Kun is ready to write code
codeTourWelcomeLead: Describe what you want. Kun, or a coding Agent you connect, reads code, edits files and runs commands in your project, shows every step, and can ask before it changes anything.
codeTourProjectNote: New tasks read, write and run commands in this folder
codeTourNoProjectNote: Pick a code folder and Kun can work in it
codeTourStep_newTask_body: New task opens a coding session in the current project. The button beside it starts a private chat with an Agent, or a group with several.
codeTourStep_projects_body: Every folder is a project, and tasks are filed under it. Add your own code folder with the folder button next to the heading.
codeTourStep_where_body: Above the composer are the current project and branch. To keep changes apart, switch to a new worktree from the branch menu first.
codeTourStep_controls_body: Pick the Agent, the approval mode and the model here. Type @ to mention files, / for commands, or drop in a screenshot.
codeTourStep_chats_title: When you're not coding, chat here
codeTourStep_chats_body: Conversations hold Kun and the Agents you've connected. Ask one privately, or start a group so several Agents discuss together.
codeTourDoneTitle: All set. Pick a way to start
codeTourDoneLead: Everything happens in {{project}}. Prompts only fill the composer; edit them before sending
codeTourDoneLeadNoProject: Prompts only fill the composer; edit them before sending
codeTourStarterExplain: Have Kun walk you through this project
codeTourStarterExplainSub: Layout, key modules and how to run it
codeTourStarterExplainPrompt: Help me get to know this project: outline the folder structure and key modules, explain how it is built and run, and list the few files you'd read first.
codeTourStarterFixSub: Fills in a bug-report prompt; add the details, then send
codeTourStarterFixPrompt: Help me fix a problem. What happens: [what you see]. Expected: [what should happen]. Steps to reproduce: [how to trigger it]. Find the cause and tell me your plan before changing anything.
codeTourStarterChatSub: Message one Agent, or bring several together
codeTourReplayHint: Replay any time from Code tour under the composer
codeTourHint: Want the tour again? Click Code tour above.
